ModMetaData.name: Grenade One-Use Patch 1.5
ModMetaData.author: Allen / ChatGPT
ModMetaData.description: Independent RimWorld 1.5 compatibility patch. Weapons using vanilla grenade-style thrown projectile logic become true consumable throwables: one physical item is consumed after each successful throw. Projectile effects, recipes, AI targeting, reloadable belts and other mod behavior remain unchanged.
